plan.text: Copper's events page lists opening day as Sunday, November 8, 2026. Its winter lift hours (no year shown): base lifts 9am to 4pm; other named lifts close between 2:30 and 3:30pm. No closing date posted.

plan.label: Lift tickets
plan.text: Copper's ticket page shows no day-ticket price. Kids 4 and under ski free; buy at least 1 day ahead for the online price. Tickets are non-refundable.

plan.label: Childcare

plan.label: Tubing

getting_there: Car: from Denver or Denver's airport (Peña Boulevard), I-70 west to exit 195. Copper posts no miles or drive time; it points to GOI70.com for I-70 travel forecasts.
Parking: the Alpine and Far East lots are free 7 days a week in winter. Ten Mile, Chapel, Beeler and Union Creek are paid but free after 2pm; Wheeler is paid. Copper posts no paid-lot rates.
Buses: the winter Snowstang bus runs from Denver Union Station or the Denver Federal Center (fare in the price list). Summit Express runs daily shuttles from Denver's airport; no fares posted.
backup: Kids' lessons: a 10% fee to cancel any time after booking, and no refund within 24 hours of the start. No weather policy posted.
Lift tickets are 100% non-refundable and non-transferable, Copper says. Tubing: 10% cancel fee, no refund within 24 hours or for missed sessions.

telluride.getting_heading: Getting there from Montrose and Telluride airports
getting_there: Car: Telluride's travel page gives Montrose airport (MTJ) as a 75-minute drive to Mountain Village, and also as about 65.5 miles and 1 hour 30 minutes. Telluride's own airport (TEX) is 15 minutes; Durango and Grand Junction about 2.5 hours.
Shuttles: the travel page lists six airport shuttle companies; no fares posted.

Parking: Carhenge in town is free (no parking 2am to 7am), served by the free Galloping Goose bus. Mountain Village's Heritage Garage is free 4pm to 10pm (7 ft 6 in clearance). The Gondola Parking Garage's daytime rate isn't posted; Silverjack rates are in the price list.
backup: Lift tickets: no refunds for unused tickets because of weather, Telluride's ski page says. No ski school weather policy posted.
Nursery: free to cancel 72 hours ahead; 50% back inside 72 hours; nothing back on the day.

plan.text: Crested Butte's hours page says winter 2026/27 starts Nov 25, open daily 9am to 4pm. Its arrival page says Nov 23 (no year). No closing date; ski school hours "TBD".

plan.text: Crested Butte's arrival page says the resort "does not offer childcare services."

plan.label: Lessons
plan.text: Child groups are for ages 7 to 14; under 7 ski in smaller ability-based groups, and ages 3 to 4 book Cubs private lessons. Kids must be potty trained and wear a helmet.

plan.label: Lesson morning
plan.text: Half day 9:30am to noon; full day 9:30am to 3:30pm, lunch with full-day groups only. Arrive 30 minutes early, 60 with rentals. Every child needs a lift ticket or pass.

crested-butte.getting_heading: Getting there from Gunnison and Montrose airports
getting_there: Car: Gunnison-Crested Butte airport (GUC) is 30 to 40 minutes away. Montrose is 94 miles: US-50 east to Gunnison, then CO-135 north. US-50 construction can cause delays; check cotrip.org.
Flights: GUC has American and United nonstops from Dallas, Denver and Houston, the getting-here page says.
Buses: Mountain Express and the Gunnison Valley RTA are free and drop you at the base, which the resort suggests over parking. Bustang runs from Denver; no fare posted.
Airport shuttles: Alpine Express, Dolly's Mountain Shuttle, Rocky Rides and Black Canyon Limo; no fares posted.
backup: Lessons aren't canceled for weather while the resort runs. Cancel 48 hours or more ahead for a full refund; inside 48 hours a single day costs a 50% fee. No refunds for weather, wind or snow levels.

Off the slopes: free town sledding hills (Pyramid Avenue, the Community School), the Trailhead Children's Discovery Museum, sleigh rides and dog sledding. No tubing or skating listed; no hours or prices posted.
We didn't find a lift ticket weather refund policy on the pages we read; check before you buy.
